body:
The holidays can hit some of us pretty hard sometimes. Please just be kind. Reach out to your loved ones! Tell your people you love them! ❤️ 
You never know what someone is going through. 

If you’re struggling, please reach out to someone. If you don’t have anyone, call or text the National Suicide Prevention line at 988. 
*You’re not alone!* I’ve been touched by suicide & I, myself, have felt the doubt, despair, hopelessness, loneliness, stress, unrealistic expectations, grief, financial pressure…. I get it, life is fucking hard sometimes. 

Just please remember, Right now is NOT forever! The 1 certainty in life is *change*! Always find something to be thankful for! Please if you read this, give me something you’re thankful for! 
I’m thankful for this badass community & my kids… if it weren’t for them, I wouldn’t have made it this far & I wouldn’t be who I am. ❤️

title: $CVU Quiet little defense company with a BIG backlog
body:
Ok I’ve been digging and this one feels way more real than most small caps.

Why I like it (simple):
	•	They make aerospace/defense parts & assemblies (real manufacturing, not just hype).
	•	Hidden/secret thing people miss: they have about $509M backlog (as of 9/30/25) — basically work already lined up.
	•	They’ve been getting work tied to Raytheon (RTX) like:
	•	missile wing assemblies (deliveries starting in 2026)
	•	Next Gen Jammer (Mid-Band) Lot 5 production contract up to $42.3M
	•	Another “secret” detail: some of that backlog is funded (meaning it’s more “real money approved,” not just talk).

Has anyone else looked into this one??

BTW, NOT financial advice. Do your own DD. I’m just sharing what I found. I’m just learning so I could be waaaay wrong!
